start.q: Where do I start if I have no beauty industry experience?
start.a: Everything begins with a free consultation. We assess your goals and choose the right format — training, franchise or investment. No prior experience required.

duration.q: How long does podology training take?
duration.a: The basic course takes 3 weeks of intensive training. The full program with real-client practice takes 1 to 3 months. You receive an internationally recognised certificate upon completion.

income.q: What income can I expect after training?
income.a: Our graduates earn from €2,000 per month within the first 3–6 months. Masters with a private practice reach €4,000–6,000 per month.

formats.a: Four formats: Podofooter (from €5,000), Podopoint (from €10,000), Podocentre (from €20,000) and a modular build tailored to your needs.

remote.q: Do I need to be in Montenegro to invest?
remote.a: No. Investments are fully remote — you can be in any country. Contract, reports and payments are all handled online.

guarantee.q: How is the 1% monthly return guaranteed?
guarantee.a: Returns are backed by the operating revenue of the iPODO studio network. Income is stable and independent of currency rates or financial markets. Investors receive a monthly report.

minAmount.q: What is the minimum investment amount?
minAmount.a: The minimum threshold is €100,000. At this amount your monthly income is €1,000 (€12,000 per year).
